docs(pdt42): wip — draft the platform experiences (D7)

## Intent

Assemble the transactions and services into journeys with a value proposition, so each journey can be reviewed before an MVP tests it.

## Key changes

- A new D7 chapter holds two experiences. "An app for next week" takes the adopting adults' point of view: find, check fitness, assemble for a class, use, give feedback and thanks. "List an app and hear it is used" takes the creators' point of view.
- The business model is minimal and non-profit: no revenue; value is captured as use, feedback and thanks that keep creators, and as more and better apps. The costs are the platform owner's time and almost no operating costs.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Two hints remain: no MVP tests the experiences yet (D8).
